messages:
Maya (CS): FYI PolarisHealth onboarding: noticed token costs up ~30% and p95 tail spikes after enabling auto-summarize. Renewal in ~6w — want low-risk perf fixes that keep clinical accuracy.
Sam (Solutions): can you paste token distribution and a quick example prompt? any clinician calls about quality?
Maya (CS): token mix: 60% <=128, 30% 129-1024, 10% >1024. p95 for >1024 climbed from 1.9s -> 3.4s. clinicians reported wording shifts in discharge conclusions, not full failures.
Jordan (Polaris): accuracy on conclusions is our blocker. templates are safe; freeform narrative must be exact. need rollback criteria.
Nikhil (Eng-ML): propose hybrid approach: int8 quantized compact model for templated flows + prefix/header-based routing; full model for freeform/high-criticality. add uncertainty detector to fallback to full.
Miguel (SRE): ops note — enable KV prefix cache for repeated templates to reduce token churn. confirm cache TTL complies with PHI retention.
Sam (Solutions): suggested canary config:
{"traffic_split": {"compact-q1": 0.2, "full-v3": 0.8}, "quant_profile": "int8-safe", "routing_rules": [{"match": "header:X-Polaris-Template", "route": "compact-q1"}, {"match": "intent:critical", "route": "full-v3"}], "excludes": ["/compliance/*"]}
Maya (CS): Jordan — can your team add header `X-Polaris-Template: discharge_v2` for server requests so routing is deterministic?
Jordan (Polaris): yes, 2 dev days. we'll also mark audited endpoints to be excluded.
Nikhil (Eng-ML): I'll prepare a 50-case eval harness (golden discharge notes) to compare ROUGE/EM and clinical QA between full-v3 and compact-q1 int8. will surface hallucination regressions.
Sam (Solutions): rollout plan: 48h shadowing -> 5% traffic for 6h -> 20% if stable. alerts for quality and latency.
Miguel (SRE): deploy-bot, schedule shadowing and staged rollout; auto-rollback if p99 > 4s or quality drop > 2%.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: shadow=48h -> rollout=5% for 6h -> auto-rollback thresholds set. console: https://console.redwood.internal/canaries/7165432100
Maya (CS): action items for renewal deck: cost delta estimate, rollback criteria, eval plan, timeline. I'll run enablement to tag templates with Polaris.
Jordan (Polaris): confirmed. include excludes for compliance endpoints.
Nikhil (Eng-ML): will log uncertainty scores and mismatches to private bucket for manual review.
Maya (CS): thanks team — will report results after 72h of shadowing.
